summary: Entergy Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $1.5 billion aggregate principal amount of junior subordinated debentures in two tranches due 2056 and 2058, with initial fixed interest at 6.500% that resets to a five-year Treasury rate plus a spread after 2036 and 2033, respectively. The offerings closed on August 7, 2026, under an existing Form S-3 shelf registration statement. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring, and therefore does not fall under any special-situations category.
